message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places to get tickets for the next NBA game:

## Official Sources (Recommended)

**1. NBATickets.com** — The NBA's official ticket hub
- This is the league's one-stop shop that links directly to each team's official ticketing options
- You can buy directly from the team or browse verified resale marketplace options
- Tickets are 100% authentic and guaranteed
- Visit: http://nbatickets.nba.com

**2. Ticketmaster** — Official Ticketing Partner of the NBA
- The primary official platform for most NBA teams
- Offers 100% verified tickets, including Verified Resale tickets
- All-in pricing shows full cost upfront (including fees)
- Website: https://www.ticketmaster.com/nba
- Also available via mobile app

## Reputable Secondary Marketplaces

If official sources are sold out, these platforms offer buyer protections:

| Platform | Notable Features |
|----------|---------------|
| **StubHub** | FanProtect Guarantee, seat view previews, pricing assistant |
| **SeatGeek** | Interactive seat maps, ticket ratings based on price/view value |
| **Vivid Seats** | 140M+ tickets sold since 2001, rewards program |
| **TickPick** | No hidden fees, price drop notifications |
| **Gametime** | Last-minute deals, birds-eye seat view |

## Tips for Buying NBA Tickets

- **Best time to buy**: When the schedule is released (typically August) and single-game tickets go on sale
- **For sold-out games**: Keep checking back closer to game day, as more tickets often become available
- **Avoid scams**: Only purchase from official sources or reputable marketplaces with buyer guarantees
- **Compare prices**: Check multiple platforms, as prices fluctuate based on demand

For the most secure experience, start with **NBATickets.com** or **Ticketmaster**, then compare secondary options if needed.
